name: @openclinxr/xr-sync-server
purpose: Server-authoritative encounter sync over Colyseus: validated intents in, ack or reject out, state via schema patches.

exportSummaries.AckMessage: Server reply for an applied intent, carrying the round-trip terminus.
exportSummaries.ENCOUNTER_ROOM_NAME: Matchmaking name clients join to reach the authoritative encounter room.
exportSummaries.EncounterServer: Handle to a running encounter server with its bound address.
exportSummaries.EncounterServerOptions: Options for booting an in-process encounter server.
exportSummaries.IntentMessage: Wire envelope for one client intent.
exportSummaries.RejectMessage: Server reply for a rejected intent.
exportSummaries.createEncounterServer: Boot one encounter room on an HTTP and WebSocket transport, then listen.
